stories.story: As the project owner, I want observable heartbeats for long-running CI workloads, so that slow work is distinguishable from missing progress without killing healthy tests.

criteria.then: Report elapsed time and age of last observed output, or explicitly report no output yet.
Warn about missing output without declaring a hang or terminating the subprocess.
Preserve its exit result and actual output; never convert a failure into success.

criteria.given: The mandatory CI runs its long asset, test and packaging workloads
criteria.then: Use the heartbeat wrapper without removing existing hard deadlines, coverage or security checks.

stories.scope: Long subprocesses in the reusable CI workflow; progress signals are subprocess output and liveness, not proof of internal progress.
stories.constraints: No new paid service or external dependency; no silent-time termination; retain existing blocking gates and job deadlines.
stories.assumptions: Default heartbeat 30 seconds, silence warning 120 seconds; tune from observed logs.
stories.dependencies: Python standard library; existing GitHub Actions jobs; PR #26 story protocol
stories.impact: CI diagnostics only; no runtime or release version change.

stories.source: Owner request 2026-11-26: monitor tests, consolidate branches and close superseded PRs without conflicts.
stories.story: As the owner, I want all retained fixes reconciled against one tested development revision so obsolete PRs can close without losing changes.

criteria.given: The verified asset changes from PR #24 overlap CI heartbeat
criteria.then: The explicit GLB validation and test fixtures, stable sorting locale and coverage source are preserved alongside heartbeat.
The story gate, production build, security and blocking SonarCloud all execute without lowering thresholds.

stories.scope: Consolidate PR #24 with heartbeat in PR #27; close superseded PRs after verifying retained changes; keep release version separate.
stories.constraints: No production publication from this quality PR; no bypass or loss of coverage, tests or canonical source.
stories.assumptions: PR #26 is already merged; exact integrated revision needs fresh gates.
stories.dependencies: PR #24 verifier and fixtures; PR #27 heartbeat; merged #26 RTM.
stories.impact: CI and office validation; no version bump.
